text: 中关村储能产业技术联盟（CNESA）理事长陈海生在第十一届储能西部论坛上发布数据：预计2026年中国新型储能累计装机规模在保守与理想场景下分别达200.7GW与221.9GW；预计2030年在保守与理想场景下分别达371.2GW与450.7GW。2026至2030年，保守与理想场景的年均复合增长率分别约20.7%和25.5%。（上证报）
text_en: Chen Haisheng, chairman of the China Energy Storage Alliance (CNESA), released data at the 11th Western Energy Storage Forum: In conservative and ideal scenarios, China's cumulative new energy storage installations are expected to reach 200.7 GW and 221.9 GW respectively in 2026; by 2030, 371.2 GW and 450.7 GW respectively. From 2026 to 2030, the average annual compound growth rates in conservative and ideal scenarios are about 20.7% and 25.5% respectively. (Shanghai Securities News)
